ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a central carbon-like intersection point, connected to a Br to the left, a Br upward, a Br downward, and PPh3 to the right; above it there is also a negatively signed Br−, which has only curved arrows with the central structure and no bond. There is also a plus sign marked in the figure, and the curved arrows need to be ignored. Reasoning: According to the question, exclude all bonds involving hydrogen and ignore the arrows. There are 3 bonds from the central atom to the three Br atoms; there is 1 bond from the central atom to P in PPh3; PPh3 indicates that P is connected to three phenyl groups, so there are 3 P–phenyl bonds; the three benzene rings each have 6 intraring C–C bonds, for a total of 3 × 6 = 18. The separate Br− is not bonded and contributes 0 bonds. Total = 3 + 1 + 3 + 18 = 25.

method.method_draft: First describe the drawn structure: a central carbon-like junction has three C–Br bonds and one C–P bond to PPh3; a separate Br− is present but not bonded. From the text, exclude all H bonds and disregard arrows. Count by components: central C–Br bonds = 3, central C–P bond = 1, P–phenyl bonds in PPh3 = 3, and three phenyl rings contribute 3 × 6 = 18 C–C bonds. Total = 3 + 1 + 3 + 18 = 25.

method.method_draft: Convert the drawing into a heavy-atom graph after ignoring arrows and hydrogens. The three phenyl rings contribute a heavy-degree sum of 3 × 13 = 39. Phosphorus has four heavy neighbors: three phenyl carbons and the central carbon, so degree 4. The central carbon has four heavy neighbors: P and three Br atoms, so degree 4. The three covalently attached Br atoms contribute degree 3 total; the separate Br− contributes 0. Sum of heavy-atom incidences = 39 + 4 + 4 + 3 = 50, so the number of non-H bonds is 50 ÷ 2 = 25.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中显示一个过渡态结构，中心位置有一个碳原子骨架与右侧的 PPh3 相连；中心碳还分别与左侧、上方、下方三个 Br 相连。右侧的 PPh3 表示磷原子连接三个苯基。图中上方还有一个单独的 Br−，并有弯箭头；另有反应箭头/电子箭头标记。按题意忽略所有箭头，并且不计涉及氢的键。

推理：把结构转化为只含重原子的图。三个苯基各自有 6 个环内 C–C 重原子键，并且各有 1 个 P–C 键，所以每个苯基连同其 P–C 连接贡献 7 个非氢键，三个苯基共 3 × 7 = 21 个非氢键。中心部分中，磷还与中心碳有 1 个 P–C 键；中心碳与三个共价连接的 Br 各有 1 个 C–Br 键，共 3 个。单独的 Br−没有共价键，贡献 0。总数 = 21 + 1 + 3 = 25。等价地，用方法草案的重原子度数和计算：三个苯基重原子度数和为 3 × 13 = 39，P 的重原子度数为 4，中心碳度数为 4，三个连接的 Br 度数和为 3，游离 Br−为 0，总度数和 39 + 4 + 4 + 3 = 50，非氢键数为 50 ÷ 2 = 25。
